# openinfra Provider

Manage [open-infra](https://github.com/harn3ss/open-infra) resources (applications, databases, virtual machines, …) declared as Kubernetes custom resources.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `context` (String) Kubeconfig context to use. Defaults to the file's current context.
- `kubeconfig` (String) Path to a kubeconfig file. Defaults to in-cluster credentials when running inside the cluster, otherwise `$KUBECONFIG` or `~/.kube/config`.
